description: This Java class defines the 'InterestIncentives' entity within a financial application, representing incentives associated with interest rate chart slabs. It includes fields for referencing related interest rate slabs and incentive details, along with methods for updating and retrieving these fields.

classes.name: InterestIncentives
classes.description: A domain entity representing incentives linked to specific interest rate chart slabs, with functionality for updating fields and maintaining associations.

methods.name: InterestIncentives (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new InterestIncentives object with a given interest rate chart slab and incentive fields. Also registers the incentive with the slab.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the InterestIncentives object based on a JsonCommand, tracking changes, validating data, and considering locale.
